citations.citation: Murrell B, Weaver S, Smith MD, Wertheim JO, Murrell S, Aylward A, Eren K, Pollner T, Martin DP, Frost SDW, Kosakovsky Pond SL (2015). Gene-Wide Identification of Episodic Selection. Mol Biol Evol 32(5): 1365-1371.

analysis.description: BUSTED uses a random effects likelihood approach to test whether a gene has experienced positive selection at any site on specified (or all) branches of a phylogeny.
analysis.name: Branch-Site Unrestricted Statistical Test for Episodic Diversification

codon_mg94.description: Muse-Gaut 1994 x GTR codon model with shared global omega

constrained.description: Constrained null BUSTED model fixing omega_k <= 1 on test branches

test.annotation: Rate classes 1 and 2 collapsed into identical omega

nucleotide_gtr.description: General Time Reversible nucleotide model with empirical frequencies

unconstrained.description: Unconstrained BUSTED mixture model allowing omega_k > 1

test.annotation: Rate classes 0 and 1 collapsed into identical omega

constrained_evidence_ratio.description: Per-site Evidence Ratio favoring positive selection against constrained (omega_K=1) alternative model

constrained_log_l.description: Site log-likelihood under constrained null model

evidence_ratio.description: Per-site Evidence Ratio favoring positive selection against optimized null model

gene_level.alternative_hypothesis: omega_k > 1 for at least one k on test branches (Unconstrained model)
gene_level.null_hypothesis: omega_k <= 1 for all k on test branches (Constrained model)
